label: EWSR1::ETV4

sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 2130 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: ETV4 encodes an ETS-family transcription factor.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 2118 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: EWSR1::ETV4 is a rare Ewing sarcoma fusion documented in molecularly characterized tumors. The reviewed cohort included an infant with an EWSR1::ETV4-positive paraspinal/pelvic soft-tissue tumor containing prominent calcification.

audit_evidence.scope: Direct cohort includes 26 EWSR1-ERG tumors and rare EWSR1-ETV1/4 tumors. Figure 4 shows EWSR1-ERG examples; Figures 3–4 show EWSR1-ETV4 infant case. No pair-specific functional transactivation experiment.

report_comment.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription. ETV4 encodes an ETS-family transcription factor. EWSR1::ETV4 is a rare Ewing sarcoma fusion documented in molecularly characterized tumors.
